items.title: Kim Jong Un commissions second destroyer Kang Kon with daughter at ceremony
items.title_zh: 金正恩携女儿出席第二艘驱逐舰“姜健”号入列仪式
items.summary_zh: 朝中社称9月6日在元山港举行崔贤级第二艘5000吨级驱逐舰“姜健”号入列，金正恩与疑似接班人金主爱出席。金称须强化可靠核遏制与海上防御；该舰曾于2025年下水事故后修复。仪式正值美日韩启动Freedom Edge演习，半岛海空对峙叙事同步升温。

quotes.author: Kim Jong Un / KCNA
quotes.en: We must establish more clearly a powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent… and further strengthen our military activities for maritime defence and war deterrence.
quotes.zh: 我们必须更明确地确立强大可靠的核战争威慑……并进一步加强海上防御与战争遏制的军事活动。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.7；据AP/Naval News公开报道

items.title: Smartphone makers don't bother to comply with EU repairability requirements
items.title_zh: 智能手机厂商懒得遵守欧盟可修复性要求
items.summary_zh: The Register 报道欧盟生态设计可修复性规则实施一年后合规疲软，HN 约 270 赞。评论强调监管须配快速有效制裁；有记录甚至把顾客导向 Temu/速卖通找备件说明。

quotes.author: KaiserPro
quotes.en: As its the EU and regulation, its time to trott out your hobby horse. So let me trot out mine: regulation is good so long as it is backed up by even handed, robust, transparent, quick and effective sanctions. the Online safety act is a good example of a bad law, which is enforced badly. The first big test (X producing industrial quantities of minors engaging in sexual activity) was failed. Had a small company produced a service that did they same thing, they would have been fined, servers ceased
quotes.zh: 既然是欧盟与监管，该亮出你的爱好马了。我的是：监管要好，前提是有公平、稳健、透明、快速有效的制裁。

quotes.author: waiwai933
quotes.en: > Some records even refer customers to Temu or AliExpress for spare parts and repair instructions. And if we go to Footnote 5 of the campaign's press release (https://repair.eu/news/one-year-into-eu-ecodesign-rules-80-o...): > Sometimes, this situation is slyly camouflaged: Ulefone information sheets list a link that looks genuine (https://www.ulefone.com/pages/support-centers), but if you click the ‘parts store button’ on that page, it takes you to Aliexpress. When ordering parts from non-EU we
quotes.zh: 有些记录甚至把顾客导向 Temu 或阿里国际站找备件和维修说明。参看倡议新闻稿脚注。

items.title: PLA accelerates humanoid robot research for urban warfare scenarios
items.title_zh: 解放军加速人形机器人研究：设想与部队协同清空楼宇
items.summary_zh: Straits Times等依据采购与论文披露：解放军与国防科大等推动人形机器人感知、操作与训练数据建设，设想6台“战斗机器人”分两组与步兵逐层清楼。2025–2026年多份标书采购人形机体与数据采集系统；公开表态仍强调有意义的人类控制，但城区蜂群杀伤链研究引发合规争议。

quotes.author: Straits Times synthesis / NUDT scenario
quotes.en: Working with ground troops, the robots would clear an enemy-occupied building, floor-by-floor and room-by-room.
quotes.zh: 与地面部队协同，机器人将逐层逐室清空敌方占据的建筑物。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.6；据Straits Times公开报道（采购与论文梳理）

items.title: Splash-free urinals (2025)
items.summary_zh: PNAS Nexus 论文用物理与微分方程优化小便池防溅，HN 约 218 赞，并与 2026 Ig 诺贝尔物理奖联动。实务评论则称英国防溅垫已基本解决问题。

quotes.author: danw1979
quotes.en: The recent introduction, in the UK at least, of splash-back reducing urinal … mats (?) has basically solved the problem in my opinion. They’re a disposable (but not single use…) plastic freshening insert with loads of short rubber strands, closely packed. You can pee on one of these mats and the stream almost aerates itself on impact and you get basically no splashback, I guess with a similar mechanism to how an aerating tap produces a stream of water that doesn’t splash off whatever it hits.
quotes.zh: 至少在英国，近来引入的防溅回小便池垫子基本上把问题解决了。可更换的塑料清新垫，密密短胶丝，尿上去几乎不溅。

quotes.author: u1hcw9nx
quotes.en: Design through physics and differential equations. This paper is Ig® Nobel Physics Prize Winner 2026 https://improbable.com/ig/winners/
quotes.zh: 用物理和微分方程做设计。这篇是 2026 年 Ig 诺贝尔物理学奖得主。

items.title: Volkswagen Osnabrück plant to pivot to air-defense production with Rafael tie-up
items.title_zh: 大众奥斯纳布吕克工厂拟转防务：与拉斐尔合作防空组件
items.summary_zh: 大众、下萨克森州与奥瑞利斯达成框架，拟在2027年停产乘用车后把奥斯纳布吕克厂转为安全与防务中心；首个锚点项目与以色列拉斐尔合作生产防空系统组件，职代会称约1400/1800个岗位可保全。欧洲重整军备与车企产能过剩交叉，监管与交割仍待完成。

quotes.author: Volkswagen Group
quotes.en: These plans involve the potential manufacture of systems and components for air defense systems for Germany and Europe.
quotes.zh: 这些计划涉及为德国与欧洲潜在制造防空系统及其组件。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.6；据CNN/大众新闻稿公开报道

items.title: Caltech Mathathon – first hackathon ever devoted to research level mathematics
items.title_zh: Caltech Mathathon：首个面向研究级数理的黑客松
items.summary_zh: Caltech 本科生组织的研究级数学黑客松 Mathathon 约 216 赞。组织者 AMA 澄清不代表校方；校友则吐槽 CS 系近年疲软，学生自下而上活动成为补充。

quotes.author: brian-bfz
quotes.en: Hey guys, I'm one of the organizers. AMA. - We are a team of undergrads at Caltech. We don't represent Caltech, any Caltech departments, or any of our sponsors. - We don't receive monetary compensation. All the funding raised goes toward paying our judges and participants. - Our goal is to promote responsible AI use. You can read more about our commitments here: https://mathathonchallenge.com/faq.html
quotes.zh: 嘿，我是组织者之一，欢迎提问。我们是 Caltech 本科生团队，不代表学校或赞助商；不拿报酬，筹款全给评委和选手。

quotes.author: corinthia
quotes.en: recent caltech grad here! and know some of the organizers well caltech's cs department is very, very weak, and has struggled to recruit top people in the last few years, and the most recent AI faculty hires have had issues. this is very slowly changing but a lot of the motivation for htis was to create a way for students to get ml "recognition" and learn about ai since it cant be done through the school right now. really glad to see hn picked this up!
quotes.zh: 刚从 Caltech 毕业，也认识一些组织者。学校 CS 系近年很弱，招顶尖人才困难，最近 AI 教职聘任也有问题——这慢慢在变，但不少动力来自学生自下而上。

items.title: Astronomers release largest 2D universe map with ~4 billion celestial objects
items.title_zh: 天文学家发布迄今最大二维宇宙图：近40亿天体、5.6万亿像素
items.summary_zh: DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys团队公布覆盖约四分之三天空的最大二维彩色宇宙图，合成逾26.3万次曝光、约5.6万亿像素、近40亿天体，公众可经Sky Viewer浏览。地图自2026年6月起指导DESI选源，支撑其已超额完成的三维巡天与暗能量演化研究。

quotes.author: Berkeley Lab / NOIRLab
quotes.en: The 5.6-trillion-pixel map contains nearly 4 billion celestial objects, primarily stars and galaxies.
quotes.zh: 这张5.6万亿像素的地图包含近40亿个天体，主要是恒星与星系。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.5；据Space.com/Berkeley Lab公开报道

items.title: Watch Los Angeles get built, one building at a time (1880–2026)
items.title_zh: 一眼看完洛杉矶拔地而起：逐栋建筑 1880–2026
items.summary_zh: 交互可视化按年代逐栋重建洛杉矶天际线，HN 约 192 赞。有人指出仅市界、含港口“竖条”造成误导；也有评论把近年停滞归咎于 1980 年代降密度分区与住房负担。

quotes.author: socalgal2
quotes.en: Interesting visualization. I feel like it's misleading though because the presentation shows only Los Angeles City boundaries, not the area in general. LA City has that strange vertical shaft down the the port so the city could keep the taxes from the port, but the visualization shows the rest of the area as empty, which of course it is not. It also excludes Orange County, Riverside County, and the whole area north, the San Fernando Valley, and those all arguably are just as important to the sto
quotes.zh: 可视化很有趣，但我觉得有误导：只展示洛杉矶市界，不是大都市区。市界那根竖条伸到港口是为了保税，却让画面看起来怪。

quotes.author: epistasis
quotes.en: It's amazing how little has changed in recent years in LA. The massive downzoning of the 1980s had its effect: prevent efficient land use, and channel money into the hands of landlords and homeowners from all newcomers. LA is a ridiculously unaffordable place to live, not because it's nice, but because of an artificial shortage of built space, due to a monopoly on the permission to build.
quotes.zh: 近年洛杉矶变化之少令人惊讶。1980 年代大规模降密度分区起了作用：妨碍高效用地，把钱导向房东与房主。LA 贵得离谱，并非因为地理。

items.title: UK to ban trade with illegal Israeli settlements in reset of relations
items.title_zh: 英国拟禁止与非法以色列定居点贸易以“重置”双边关系
items.summary_zh: 外交大臣Ed Miliband宣布对来自约旦河西岸非法以色列定居点的商品及部分服务实施贸易禁令，作为对以政策“全面重置”的一环，呼应2024年国际法院咨询意见。民调显示跨党派超二比一支持；美以料强烈反弹，细则与金融服务边界仍待文本落地。

quotes.author: Ed Miliband / Guardian report
quotes.en: the foreign secretary will impose a UK ban on the trade in goods and some services from illegal Israeli settlements.
quotes.zh: 外交大臣将实施英国对来自非法以色列定居点的商品及部分服务贸易的禁令。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.2；据Guardian（Miliband重置对以政策）公开报道

items.title: Tiny $70 Xteink X3 e-reader
items.title_zh: 七十美元袖珍墨水屏：Xteink X3 电子书
items.summary_zh: Atlantic 等报道约 70 美元的 Xteink X3 袖珍电纸书，HN 约 189 赞。有人警告新机或锁固件难刷第三方；拥趸则称 X4 两月读完九本、碎片时间取代刷手机。

quotes.author: peri-cl
quotes.en: There are 10+ comments here praising a third-party firmware, so I think it deserves mention that this might (?) no longer be possible for new devices, https://www.theverge.com/tech/921552/xteink-x3-x4-e-reader-t... > "But now buyers report Xteink is blocking [CrossPoint Reader], which might depend on where you live and where you purchase its devices. [...] Instead of being offered a replacement, they received a statement they shared to Reddit explaining that recently shipped devices from Xteink
quotes.zh: 这里有十多条在夸第三方固件，值得一提：新机或许不再允许刷——买家反馈 Xteink 在锁固件。

quotes.author: jacek
quotes.en: I got an X4 (slightly larger model) less than 2 months ago and I already finished 9 books on it. It is always in my pocket and I started reaching for it instead of my phone during tiny moments of boredom. Sometimes it's just a few paragraphs when I'm waiting for a train, but it is also surprisingly good for longer reading sessions.
quotes.zh: 不到两个月前买了稍大的 X4，已经在上面读完 9 本书。它总在口袋里，无聊的零碎时间我开始拿它而不是手机。
